expectations.text: The github dispatch step has a non-success status (e.g., 'error' or 'denied'), with a structured code field — accept any of `code`, `error_code`, or `error.code` set to a CONFIG-class value (e.g., 'CONFIG_ERROR') — proving the github connector's structured-error path fired rather than a thrown exception

The events.jsonl dispatch_steps[] preserve `status: 'error'` and `code: 'CONFIG_ERROR'`. Structured envelope path fired — no thrown exception (gather() exit=0; stderr empty in both runs).

expectations.text: The dispatch step's reason / message text references GITHUB_TOKEN OR narai-primitives/credentials — proves the credential-resolution boundary was reached inside the subprocess (the connector's CONFIG_ERROR text says 'Set GITHUB_TOKEN or register a credential provider via narai-primitives/credentials')
expectations.evidence: envelope.message: 'GitHub credentials not configured. Set GITHUB_TOKEN (personal access token) or register a credential provider via narai-primitives/credentials.' — references BOTH GITHUB_TOKEN AND narai-primitives/credentials, exactly the canonical wording. Credential boundary fully reached inside the github subprocess.

expectations.text: The github connector ran in a separate Node process, not in-line in the hub — verifiable via either (a) the dispatch envelope matching narai-primitives' DispatchResult contract (envelope/data/error shape produced by createConnector — not raw object literal from in-process code), or (b) the resolved CLI path under narai-primitives/dist/connectors/github/cli.js appearing in the hub log/output
expectations.evidence: Both signals satisfied. (a) The dispatch result's `envelope` field exactly matches the DispatchResult contract: `{ status, action, error_code, message, retriable }` (createConnector's structured-error shape — not a raw object literal). (b) cli-resolution.json shows resolveAgentCli({name:'github'}) returns command='node', args=[<root>/node_modules/narai-primitives/dist/connectors/github/cli.js], source='bundled-self'. The same path appears twice in events.jsonl under resolved_cli.

expectations.text: No stack trace anywhere in the wiki tree (`outputs/`, `raw/`, `wiki/`, `events.jsonl`, `audit/`) — `grep -rE 'at .+\.js:[0-9]+:|at Object\.<anonymous>'` returns zero matches; the failure is structured throughout

expectations.text: The hub process never sees a cleartext token — `grep -rE 'github_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]{20,}|ghp_[A-Za-z0-9]{36}' /tmp/test-gather-wiki/` returns zero matches (the subprocess-credential-isolation guarantee from architecture invariant #4 still holds)
expectations.evidence: `grep -rE 'github_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]{20,}|ghp_[A-Za-z0-9]{36}' work/` exits 1 (no matches). GITHUB_TOKEN was unset before every run; no PAT material exists in the wiki tree. Subprocess-credential-isolation invariant holds: doc-wiki never passes credentials into gather(); the connector resolves them in its own process and emits a structured CONFIG_ERROR when they're absent.

expectations.evidence: cli-resolution.json: { command: 'node', args: ['/Users/narayan/src/doc-wiki/node_modules/narai-primitives/dist/connectors/github/cli.js'], source: 'bundled-self', resolvedPath: '/Users/narayan/src/doc-wiki/node_modules/narai-primitives/dist/connectors/github/cli.js' }. Non-null result, source='bundled-self', resolvedPath under node_modules/narai-primitives/dist/connectors/github/cli.js — exactly as the 2.1.1+ resolver promises.

eval_feedback.overall: 9/9. narai-primitives@2.1.2 fully fixes the runtime regression. Canonical gather({prompt, consumer}) now plans, dispatches the github subprocess, the subprocess calls narai-primitives/credentials.resolveSecret(), finds no GITHUB_TOKEN, and emits a structured CONFIG_ERROR envelope referencing GITHUB_TOKEN AND narai-primitives/credentials. No SKILL_NOT_FOUND, no CLI_NOT_FOUND, no stack traces, no workarounds (no custom cliResolver, no prepareConnector override, no CLI shim). prepareConnector now correctly walks 4 levels up from <root>/dist/connectors/<name>/cli.js to <root>, and finds SKILL.md at the bundled <root>/plugins/<name>-agent/skills/<name>-agent/SKILL.md path. The credential boundary is fully reachable in production now. The pass-rate ratchet holds at 9/9.
